success.description: You speak one of the secret names of the dark gods. Simply enunciating this word causes those around you incredible pain. Those engaged with you suffer a number of wounds, equal to your Int
Targets suffer a number of wounds equal to Int + WP + 3, +1 critical. All affected gain the Overwhelmed targets condition. All affected targets suffer 1 critical wound.

bane.description: Special: Add M to the difficulty modifier for each enemy engaged with you.

chaosStar.description: You suffer the effects of the spell.

sigmarsComet.description: All characters up to close range are affected. Suffer 1 stress and 1 fatigue.
